blocks.text: Family Fun Galore
blocks.html: Family Fun Galore

blocks.text: Dive into an extraordinary aquatic journey at our premier Underwater Observatory, Eilat!
blocks.html: Dive into an extraordinary aquatic journey at our premier Underwater Observatory, Eilat!

blocks.text: Explore the wonders of the Red Sea with captivating fish displays and interactive activities tailored for families. Beyond the Observation, we offer a one-of-a-kind experience where visitors of all ages can experience a world of marine marvels.
blocks.html: Explore the wonders of the Red Sea with captivating fish displays and interactive activities tailored for families. Beyond the Observation, we offer a one-of-a-kind experience where visitors of all ages can experience a world of marine marvels.

blocks.text: From curious children to seasoned explorers, there's something for everyone to discover. Plus, take advantage of our special offer.
blocks.html: From curious children to seasoned explorers, there's something for everyone to discover. Plus, take advantage of our special offer.

blocks.text: Every ticket allows access for three consecutive days, allowing time to explore and enjoy all that our underwater wonderland offers.
blocks.html: Every ticket allows access for three consecutive days, allowing time to explore and enjoy all that our underwater wonderland offers.

blocks.text: Looking for attractions in Eilat?
blocks.html: Looking for attractions in Eilat?

blocks.text: Discover the underwater observatory located approximately 8 km south of Eilat city center—an unforgettable experience offering a fascinating encounter with over 800 species of animals, including fish, corals, sharks, invertebrates, seals, turtles, and more from the Gulf of the Red Sea.
blocks.html: Discover the underwater observatory located approximately 8 km south of Eilat city center—an unforgettable experience offering a fascinating encounter with over 800 species of animals, including fish, corals, sharks, invertebrates, seals, turtles, and more from the Gulf of the Red Sea.

blocks.text: At our park, there's something for every age. Delve into the valleys of the Red Sea to witness the reef in all its vibrant colors and shades alongside magnificent marine life.
blocks.html: At our park, there's something for every age. Delve into the valleys of the Red Sea to witness the reef in all its vibrant colors and shades alongside magnificent marine life.

blocks.text: But that's not all—enjoy a glass-bottom boat cruise, experience a unique 3D movie at the oceanarium, witness thrilling animal feedings, and much more.
blocks.html: But that's not all—enjoy a glass-bottom boat cruise, experience a unique 3D movie at the oceanarium, witness thrilling animal feedings, and much more.

blocks.text: Are you looking for a special gift? Look no further
blocks.html: Are you looking for a special gift? Look no further

blocks.text: Step into our souvenir shop, where you'll discover various gifts and souvenirs inspired by freedom and the sea. From books to original textile products and games, there's something for everyone to treasure.
blocks.html: Step into our souvenir shop, where you'll discover various gifts and souvenirs inspired by freedom and the sea. From books to original textile products and games, there's something for everyone to treasure.

blocks.text: In addition, explore two jewelry stores offering a selection of beautiful jewelry crafted by leading designers from Israel and abroad, with some items exclusive to the Underwater Observatory that you won't find anywhere else.
blocks.html: In addition, explore two jewelry stores offering a selection of beautiful jewelry crafted by leading designers from Israel and abroad, with some items exclusive to the Underwater Observatory that you won't find anywhere else.

blocks.text: Are you feeling hungry? Head to our restaurant, serving meat and vegetarian meals suitable for the whole family. Alternatively, recharge at the cafeteria and the coffee bar on the entrance floor of the tower for a quick pick-me-up.
blocks.html: Are you feeling hungry? Head to our restaurant, serving meat and vegetarian meals suitable for the whole family. Alternatively, recharge at the cafeteria and the coffee bar on the entrance floor of the tower for a quick pick-me-up.

blocks.text: Tours for groups and events
blocks.html: Tours for groups and events

blocks.text: We offer a full day of attractions at the Underwater Observatory, including private guided tours, group games tailored to the participants, and even a branded sign with the group's name that a diver will wave from a shark pool.
blocks.html: We offer a full day of attractions at the Underwater Observatory, including private guided tours, group games tailored to the participants, and even a branded sign with the group's name that a diver will wave from a shark pool.

blocks.text: If you're interested in hosting a private or business event with us, the Underwater Observatory is the perfect location for a fully customized experience. Whether a small group of 40 or a large group of 350, we can create an unforgettable event tailored to your needs and desires.

Exemption from payment for a chaperone: A chaperone is entitled to free entry for the same activities as the cardholder.

items: Jewelry and Souvenir ShopsOur souvenir shop offers a variety of sea and holiday-inspired gifts and souvenirs, including books, games, and a selection of exclusive items.The park has two jewelry shops with a spectacular selection of original and unique jewelry created by leading Israeli and international designers. Plus, when you spend over 800 NIS in the park (including tickets), you will receive a free one-year entrance pass.To schedule a visit to the park's jewelry shops only, please call 08-6364225.

Park RestaurantsThe park's restaurant offers a fantastic selection of vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals for both children and adults, along with a range of fresh sandwiches, pizza, ice cream, desserts, and refreshing drinks.Additionally, there is the park's cafeteria and coffee bar, situated on the entrance floor of the Observatory Tower and near the AquaDome. Here, you can indulge in a variety of light meals, snacks, and beverages.Bon Appétit!

The David Friedman Educational CenterWe dream of a future where everyone actively protects and advocates the Red Sea. That's why we set up the David Friedman Educational Center.This classroom, started 17 years ago by the late David Friedman, our first Scientific Director, offers a fun and interactive space for students to learn about the marine life of the Red Sea and how to keep it safe.We host these sessions for schools in Eilat, allowing students to dive into the wonders of the Red Sea while rolling up their sleeves to help restore the reef and its surroundings.We're passionate about teaching kids to love and respect the Red Sea. In these classes, they learn all about the conservation projects at the Underwater Observatory, like helping sea turtles and seahorses thrive.

items: 1 XThe Welcome AquariumA great way to start !See a characteristic Red Sea coral reef, from all angles,from the minute you enter the park.

2 XRed Sea Coral Reef Aquarium.Description: This is a huge circular aquarium showing a replica of the magnificent coral reef of Eilat.It is one of the largest replica reefs in the world and boasts a number of real corals.Watch the Red sea in action here!

3 XThe Sting-ray caveDescription: In the Sting-ray cave resides giant sting rays measuring 2 meters and more. Take this photo opportunity and wave to your family from inside the aquarium, just like a professional diver.More Information:Advanced booking is required, only availablefrom age 8 upward.Diving is from age 8.

4 XThe Turtle PoolDescription: The turtle pool is a beautiful habitat for two types of Turtle species.In a comfortable and warm recreation of their natural living conditions, our turtle pool is a great place for you to peek in on the everyday habits of these intriguing animals.Take a look!
5 XSnorkelling poolIn the Snorkeling pool, there is, you guessed it, an opportunity to snorkel.This is also the only place you can view coral in the Underwater Observatory from an aerial view.

6 XPetting and Feeding PoolDescription: Get an interactive taste of marine life and join in by feeding and petting our Coyfish.Keep your children engaged and entertained!Details may be subject to change.

7 XShark WorldDescription: Featuring a huge shark pool, an interactive activity center and a transparent tunnel.Come face-to-fin with the predators of the Red Sea, including sharks, sting rays, manta rays, schools of fish and vibrant colonies of coral.Start a shark adventure!

8 XAquadomeDescription: Join us in the Aquadome for an intense 360 ° visual experience of whales. Uncover the many secrets from their fascinating lives and immerse yourself into a sensory experience. Dive in today!
9 XExplanation PoolsDescription: At this spot, our instructors provide in-depth information about our aquatic residents.Details may be subject to change

10 XUnderwater Observatory TowerDescription: The Observatory sits on the coral reef reserve. You can enter the Observatory and view the reef from the inside by walking down the stairs, to 6 meters below sea level.Here you can watch hundreds of species of fish, coral and invertebrates living in the magnificent Red Sea.This is a totally unique experience!
11 XPeace TerraceLook out over 4 different countries from our Peace Terrace, located at the Underwater Observatory Tower.See Israel, Jordan, Egypt and Saudi Arabia!

12 XCreatures of the DeepDescription: With several video panels screens, the Creatures of the Deep exhibition boasts intriguing and rare coverage of animals that live more than 1000 meters below the surface.This is a dark and challenging place with unique lifeforms, unreachable for the majority of people, including experienced divers.

13 XPearl Secrets.Description: Watch pearls being removed from their shells in this timeless and magical activity. Then if you so wish, pop into our Jewelry store and purchase something beautiful, rare and unique.

14 XRare Fish AquariumDescription: The Rare Fish Aquarium has 35 aquariums and over 800 species of rare and beautiful fish, coral and spectacular marine creatures.Discover the colorful and unusual predators, invertebrates, corals and fish – only found in the Gulf of Eilat!

15 XEducation CenterIn the Education center, we hold many lectures and in-depth learning sessions. You can view our conservation projects, including the rehabilitation of coral, one of our cornerstone sustainability projects

16 XCoral 2000Description: Coral 2000 is a submersible boat with 48 incredible underwater windows. Rather than looking down, the Coral 2000 gives you a panoramic view of the reef.Take this chance to meet rare fish, coral colonies and amazing sea creatures in their natural habitat. More information: * Advanced booking is required The boat departs from the Coral Pier located on the bridge leading to the Observation Tower

items: 01What is the admission fee for visiting the park? You can find all ticket prices, special offers, and packages here.

02When is the ideal time to visit? The Underwater Observatory is open daily from 9:00 am to 4:00 pm.Our marine park is spacious and offers a variety of activities, so no matter what time you choose to come, you'll have plenty to do!To make the most of your visit, we recommend planning for guided tours and observing the animals during feeding times (which are posted on our website).
03What are the feeding times for the fish and marine creatures? You can view the feeding times and guided tour schedules by clicking here.

04How much time should I plan for a visit? We recommend planning a visit of 3 to 4 hours to fully explore all that the park has to offer, including a stop at one of our top-quality on-site restaurants.

05Is the parl accessible by public transportation? Yes, you can reach the Underwater Observatory by public transport. Egged, the Israeli intercity bus service, stops at the entrance of the Underwater Observatory. The bus line number is 15.
06Is there parking available? The Underwater Observatory has large on-site parking facilities. Please take into account that on busy days and during peak season, the car park may reach full capacity.
07Do I need to print my tickets before I arrive if I book online? There is no need to print your tickets before you arrive; you can collect them at the kiosk next to the Ticket Office.
08What credit cards are accepted for payment? We accept all types of credit cards.

items: 09Do you offer any discounts or benefits for membership clubs? We collaborate with a variety of membership clubs. If you are a member of a specific club, please contact them directly to inquire about discounts and benefits for The Underwater Observatory.
10From what age are children required to pay? Children who are under 3 years old get in for free.

11Do you provide storage facilities for personal belongings? Certainly!To ensure your comfort while exploring the park, we offer locker rentals for just 5 NIS.The locker size is approximately equivalent to that of a small suitcase.

12Are visitors allowed to take photographs of the displays and exhibitions? Yes! However, to ensure the well-being of our marine creatures, please refrain from using flash photography.Feel free to capture and share your experience by uploading photos on various social networks.Don't forget to tag us!

13Is my ticket valid for multiple entries? Yes! Your ticket is valid for three consecutive days from the date of your first entry.Please note: To extend your ticket for another two days, visit the photo booth opposite the entrance.Get your photo taken and bring the photo with you when you want to return.

14Are wheelchairs available at the park? Certainly!Please approach the security guard at the entrance, and they will assist you.For your convenience, we recommend contacting us in advance at 08-6364209 to reserve a wheelchair for your visit.
15Do you have a designated area for nursing babies? An intimate and comfortable nursing area is available in the souvenir shop.
16Do you have First Aid equipment and medical staff on site? First aid equipment is available at the main office.Additionally, medics are always on-site and ready to assist if necessary.
